ink-wash-2d.heads_note: 成人档；孩童取 4-4.5。同包禁混档

palette.usage: primary 为宣纸底与留白，secondary 为灰青衣物，accent 为铜钱朱红且是全片唯一重音色

tech_spec.render_cn: 一幅平面手绘的中国水墨淡彩画，画在宣纸上，整幅压在同一个平面内。细匀墨线勾边，偶有干笔断锋；每一块颜色都是一次平涂完成。光不做塑造，近处与远处保持同样的平面感。大面积留白即为天空与地面。
tech_spec.render_en: A flat hand-painted Chinese ink-and-wash picture on xuan paper, held on one plane. Thin ink outlines with occasional dry-brush breaks; every area is one flat wash struck once. Light is not modelled, and the same flatness holds near and far. Large areas of bare paper read as sky and ground.
tech_spec.palette_cn: 低饱和配色：宣纸白、藕荷灰粉、灰青灰、赭石土黄与墨绿松针，朱红只作唯一重音色点缀。
tech_spec.palette_en: muted desaturated palette of xuan-paper white, pale lilac grey, slate blue grey, ochre earth and pine green, with a single restrained cinnabar accent
tech_spec.material_rule: 光不做塑造，每块区域从边到边是同一个明度；阴影用色块不用渐变；不写逆光轮廓光

material_budget.save: 远景群像、背景植被细节、地面纹理

collapse_risks.cause: 压句含 animation 或 storybook 或否定句；正文有横向位移产生视差；参考图本身半立体

collapse_risks.fix: 压句逐字复用；禁写高光与渐变

collapse_risks.fix: 锁手绘轨；轮廓线写 thin even ink outlines

collapse_risks.cause: 没写色彩预算

palette.usage: primary 为深夜蓝阴影与夜空，secondary 为月光冷蓝主光，accent 为灯笼暖橙且是全片唯一暖色重音色

tech_spec.render_cn: 一部哥特维多利亚定格木偶电影，手作暗黑童话，按真实微缩布景实拍方式呈现，手工痕迹清晰可见。伯顿式木偶：头大、四肢细长、骨骼解剖歪扭、尸感面孔、哑光黏土皮肤；每一处动作都保留轻微的定格动画不完美。月光蓝照明、深长阴影、去饱和蓝灰色调、德国表现主义布景，每一处表面都哑光不反光。
tech_spec.render_en: A Gothic Victorian stop-motion puppet film, a handcrafted dark fairytale shot as real miniature set photography with visible handmade textures. Burton-esque puppets with oversized heads, thin elongated limbs, crooked skeletal anatomy, corpse-like faces and matte clay skin; subtle stop-motion imperfections stay in every movement. Moonlit blue lighting, deep shadows, a desaturated blue-grey palette, German expressionist sets, and every surface matte and non-glossy.
tech_spec.palette_cn: 去饱和蓝灰色调：月光冷蓝、深夜蓝阴影、苍白黏土肤色与做旧粗布，灯笼暖橙作唯一重音色。
tech_spec.palette_en: desaturated blue-grey palette of moonlit cold blue, deep night-blue shadow, pale clay skin and weathered cloth, with a single warm lantern-orange accent
tech_spec.material_rule: 每一处都保留轻微的定格动画不完美；不用丝滑运动模糊；每个材质词后跟哑光不反光

material_budget.main: 面部黏土质感与手工痕迹（指痕、接缝、不对称、尸感灰白）
material_budget.second: 布料做旧与微缩布景的模型痕迹
material_budget.save: 远景群像（压成蓝灰剪影）、背景陈设细节、天空与远景
forbidden_material: 皮肤高光与次表面散射

tech_spec.render_cn: 一幅写实电影画面，PBR 真实材质与真实的电影布光。皮肤能看到毛孔、细纹与轻微不对称，绝不光滑无瑕、绝不磨皮。布料织纹、潮湿石面与风化木料在近距离都清晰可辨。单一有依据的光源，衰减自然，带体积雾，极轻的胶片颗粒。
tech_spec.render_en: A photoreal live-action film frame with PBR materials and real cinematic lighting. Skin shows pores, fine lines and slight asymmetry, never flawless or airbrushed. Cloth weave, damp stone and weathered wood all read at close range. One motivated light source with natural falloff, volumetric haze, very light film grain.
tech_spec.palette_cn: 低饱和配色：冷灰、土黄与深褐，唯一暖色重音由画面里唯一的实用光源承担。
tech_spec.palette_en: desaturated palette of cold grey, earth ochre and deep brown, with a single warm accent hue carried by the only practical light source
tech_spec.material_rule: 皮肤必须带不完美（毛孔 / 细纹 / 轻微不对称），至少带两项；光源方向必须写明，衰减自然

tech_spec.render_cn: 一幅国漫 2D 动画赛璐璐上色的画面，线条流畅清晰，色块干净，阴影是边缘分明的两段式阴影，亮部与暗部之间不做过渡。大眼带一处清晰高光，轮廓线均匀，无渐变，无噪点颗粒。单一光源，整张画面光照统一。
tech_spec.render_en: A Chinese 2D animation frame in clean cel-shading, with smooth confident linework, flat colour areas and two-tone shading split by a hard edge. Large eyes with a single crisp catchlight, even outlines, no gradient, no grain. One light source, unified lighting across the whole frame.
tech_spec.palette_cn: 干净明快的赛璐璐配色：阴影是固有色加深一档，不是灰也不是黑，每帧只保留一个重音色。
tech_spec.palette_en: clean saturated cel-shading palette where shadow is the local colour one step darker, never grey or black, with a single accent hue per frame
tech_spec.material_rule: 暗部 = 固有色加深一档，绝不用灰或黑当阴影；材质用形状化色块 + 明确高光形状表达

tech_spec.render_cn: 一幅三渲二卡通着色的 3D 画面：角色是有体积的三维实体，任意角度转面都保持一致，明暗是两段式的平涂色，中间分界硬。轮廓线均匀，色块干净，无渐变，无噪点颗粒，无运动模糊。单一主光，整张画面光照统一。
tech_spec.render_en: A cel-shaded 3D render: solid three-dimensional characters with real volume that stay consistent from every angle, shaded in two flat tones with a hard edge between them. Even outlines, flat colour areas, no gradient, no grain, no motion blur. One key light, unified lighting across the frame.
tech_spec.palette_cn: 干净的三渲二配色：阴影是固有色加深一档，不是灰也不是黑，每帧只保留一个重音色。
tech_spec.palette_en: clean cel-shaded palette where shadow is the local colour one step darker, never grey or black, with a single accent hue per frame

tech_spec.render_en: Footage shot by a real camera in a real location: available light only, natural handheld micro-shake, unposed subjects with everyday imperfections.
